answer: Plot each identity as a point in trait-space; a sybil fleet collapses into a nebula of near-clones. Apply a ferrous pull: cluster behavioral embeddings each epoch, and identities whose nearest-neighbor similarity clears a threshold share their epoch reward with the cluster. The attacker pays in divergence: every fake must behave differently to escape the magnet, yet divergent agents earn less from the common pool, so fleet payoff falls as headcount rises. The cluster map re-derives from the ledger, so the check is replayable. Honest singletons never cluster; only fleets do — jade-rare part.
